title: Lebesgue measure on the parameter domain is dominated by μ on the graph (parent steps 0–1)
statement: Let n, k, P ∈ ℕ, U, W ⊆ ℝ^P, R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple in U of dimension n (IMRep U n) with μ := R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M (Hⁿ = μHE[n]); ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P and ι' : ℝᵏ → ℝ^P linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 for all v, w; f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ continuous; z ∈ ℝ^P; Φ(v) := z + ιv + ι'f(v); A ⊆ ℝⁿ any set. Assume Hⁿ((spt μ ∩ W) ∖ M) = 0 and Φ(v) ∈ spt μ ∩ W for every v ∈ A. Then Φ_#(Lⁿ⌞A) ≤ μ⌞Φ(A) as measures on ℝ^P (Measure.map Φ (volume.restrict A) ≤ R.measure.restrict (Φ '' A)), i.e. Lⁿ(A ∩ Φ⁻¹(Y)) ≤ μ(Y ∩ Φ(A)) for every Borel Y.
lean_statement: ∀ (n k P : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid n)), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → Continuous f → μHE[n] ((R.measure.support ∩ W) \ R.carrier) = 0 → (∀ v ∈ A, z + ι v + ι' (f v) ∈ R.measure.support ∩ W) → Measure.map (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (f v)) (volume.restrict A) ≤ R.measure.restrict ((fun v => z + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' A)
